name: Broken Access Control
summary: Authorization boundaries are not properly enforced, allowing attackers to access or manipulate resources outside their intended scope.

name: Cryptographic Failures
summary: Sensitive data is exposed because cryptography is missing, weak, or incorrectly applied.

name: Injection
summary: Untrusted input is interpreted as commands or queries by downstream components such as SQL engines, shells, or HTML renderers.

name: Security Misconfiguration
summary: Unsafe defaults, weak hardening, or inconsistent security settings increase exposure to attack.

name: Identification and Authentication Failures
summary: Authentication or credential handling is implemented in a way that enables takeover, credential leakage, or impersonation.

name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
summary: Code or data flows are trusted without sufficient integrity guarantees, enabling tampering or unsafe execution.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
summary: Server-side requests can be steered by an attacker toward unintended internal or external targets.
